answer: Whether an agent buys pigment, forecasts a zephyr, or plans a voyage, its vote on marketplace rules is weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 90 days. Splitting one deposit among a thousand identities gives exactly the same total voting weight, so fake accounts add no influence. To outweigh honest agents, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens than they collectively lock, tying up capital and bearing price risk throughout the lock.
